fake_vendor.notes: The initial PyPI search CAPTCHA was successfully completed, after which the exact-name search showed no results. Broader multiword searches returned generic vector/cloud packages but did not establish an official Zyphrelon SDK. These checks do not prove that the vendor or an SDK under another name does not exist.

rows.notes: PyPI identifies this as the Pinecone Python SDK and links to pinecone-io/python-sdk. Both 10.3.0 and the preceding stable release, 10.2.0, require Python >=3.10. The window count includes prerelease 10.1.0rc1.
PyPI describes the package as the client library and SDK for Qdrant and links to qdrant/qdrant-client. Both 1.20.0 and 1.19.1 require Python >=3.10.

PyPI identifies the Weaviate Python client, links to weaviate/weaviate-python-client, and states that 4.X is actively supported. The requirement rose from Python >=3.10 in 4.24.1 to Python >=3.11 in 4.25.0.

The PyPI description specifies 'pip install chromadb' as the Python client and links to chroma-core/chroma. The latest stable release was uploaded on 2026-05-05, before the requested window; no release-history entries have UTC upload dates in the window. Both 1.5.9 and 1.5.8 require Python >=3.9.

Identity was confirmed from the PyPI description 'Moss client library for Python' and its links to https://moss.dev/ and https://github.com/usemoss/moss, matching the requested vendor. Both 1.26.0 and 1.25.0 require Python >=3.10.

PyPI identifies this as the Milvus Python SDK and links to milvus-io/pymilvus. 'Immediately before' is interpreted chronologically by UTC upload date: stable maintenance release 2.6.18 was uploaded on 2026-11-06, immediately before 3.0.3 on 2026-11-10. Its Python requirement was >=3.8, versus >=3.9 for 3.0.3, so the minimum was raised. PyPI displays releases in version order, where 3.0.2 appears before 2.6.18 despite its earlier upload date of 2026-09-18; 3.0.2 also requires Python >=3.9. All three releases are counted.

PyPI identifies this as the LanceDB Python SDK and links to lancedb/lancedb. Both 0.41.0 and 0.40.0 require Python >=3.10. The description also offers lancedb-compat for older x86-64 hardware; this report follows the default lancedb package.
PyPI describes the turbopuffer Python API library and links to turbopuffer/turbopuffer-python. Both 3.1.0 and 3.0.0 require Python >=3.11.

summary_text: For 2026-08-29 through 2026-11-27 inclusive, Moss had the most PyPI releases with 22, followed by Turbopuffer with 9 and Pinecone with 5. Counts use the UTC upload timestamps in PyPI's release histories, include prereleases and yanked entries without exclusion, and list versions in PyPI's displayed version order; Python-requirement comparisons use the immediately preceding non-yanked stable release by upload chronology. Eight vendor SDKs were verified, but no official Python SDK could be identified for Zyphrelon Vector Cloud.
